evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Joanna moved directly into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by customer in step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Joanna quoted Saturday the 31st at $111/hour per mover, $222/hour for two men, with estimated 6–8 hour job ($1,776 total). No mention of cheaper days or date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rate lock and no deposit stated first: 'no deposit required payment is only upon completion of the move.' Then ask: 'Would you like your help for this move on the thirty first?' Customer said yes. However, the ask came with a built-in conditional (first job of the day timing), not a plain ask.

top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics comprehensively (addresses, property details, floor plan, room breakdown, special items, packing status, box count, parking access) and confirmed all booking details at the end, leaving nothing vague.
coaching_note: Ask the two-concerns question before probing logistics—this is the primary opener for step 2 and anchors the entire conversation to what matters to the customer. Currently you are jumping straight to the checklist.
